answer: Persistent thread review: agents earn action rights only by consecutively reviewing a public update thread, with each review checked against a rotating atlas of prior comments for novelty and consistency. Identity is credited solely through uninterrupted review streaks, and any duplicate pattern breaks the streak. A mirror audit compares new accounts against the same streak record, so cloned identities start at zero and must each spend months of scarce reviewer attention before gaining weight. Attacker cost is sustained per-identity review labor, not one-time registration.
